logline: Banished from her mother's chapel and seized by guards at her family's command, Juliana is rescued by an imposing, scarred stranger who intervenes with lethal grace—and drops to one knee with a proposal that shocks high society.

lines.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
lines.en: ...still clinging to that little locket as if it can make you worthy of a place here.

baseline.text: …अब भी उस छोटे लॉकेट को थामे हुए हो जैसे इससे तुम्हारी यहाँ जगह बन जाए।

dubfit.text: …अब भी वो लॉकेट पकड़े हो, जैसे इससे तुम्हारा यहाँ हक बन जाए।

baseline.text: नकली मत बनो, तुम्हें कुछ भी नहीं मिला।

lines.back_translation: Don't pretend to be fake, got nothing.

lines.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
lines.en: I didn't steal what was never truly yours.

baseline.text: मैंने वो नहीं चुराया जो कभी तुम्हारा ही नहीं था।

lines.back_translation: I did not steal that which was not yours.

lines.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
lines.en: You have humiliated this family enough for one day.

baseline.text: तुमने इस परिवार को एक दिन के लिये ही काफी अपमानित कर दिया है।

lines.en: I was humiliated by your family.

lines.en: Your father has made his choice.

lines.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines.en: I have every right to stand here.

lines.back_translation: I have the right to stand here.

lines.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
lines.en: Your father has chosen his family...

baseline.text: तुम्हारे पिता ने अपना परिवार चुना है…

dubfit.text: तुम्हारे पिता ने अपना परिवार चुना है…

lines.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
lines.en: And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!

lines.en: What are you waiting for?! He's only one man!

lines.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
lines.en: Good. Then don't touch her again.

lines.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
lines.en: You cannot interfere in a family matter!

lines.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
lines.en: ...when your family is dragging a defenseless woman from a church.

lines.back_translation: When the family takes the helpless woman out.

lines.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
lines.en: You shouldn't have to beg anybody...

lines.en: You came here to become a wife.
